avoid_supplements.name: Contrast dye (iodinated)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Risk of lactic acidosis and acute kidney injury; metformin should be held before contrast administration
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue metformin 48 hours before iodinated contrast procedures; restart only after renal function confirmed stable

avoid_supplements.name: Alcohol (excessive)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases risk of lactic acidosis by impairing lactate clearance and reducing hepatic gluconeogenesis
avoid_supplements.action: Limit alcohol to ≤1-2 drinks per day; avoid binge drinking

caution_supplements.name: Chromium
caution_supplements.mechanism: May enhance insulin sensitivity and hypoglycemic effects; additive glucose-lowering action
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose closely; may require metformin dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential additive glucose-lowering effects through enhanced insulin sensitivity
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for hypoglycemia; inform patient of combined glucose-lowering potential

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have mild glucose-lowering properties; additive effects possible
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; clinical significance typically minimal

avoid_foods.name: High-fat meals (excessive)
avoid_foods.mechanism: May delay metformin absorption and reduce gastrointestinal tolerability; increases GI side effects
avoid_foods.action: Take metformin with meals containing moderate fat; avoid large fatty meals

caution_foods.name: Vitamin B12-depleting foods (if deficiency risk)
caution_foods.mechanism: Metformin reduces B12 absorption; high-risk patients benefit from B12-rich foods
caution_foods.action: Encourage intake of B12-rich foods (meat, dairy, fortified cereals); monitor B12 levels annually in at-risk patients

caution_foods.name: High-fiber foods
caution_foods.mechanism: May improve glycemic control but can increase GI side effects if introduced too rapidly
caution_foods.action: Gradually increase fiber intake; ensure adequate hydration

monitoring_notes: Monitor renal function (eGFR/serum creatinine) regularly, as metformin is contraindicated in severe renal impairment (eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73m²). Assess for vitamin B12 deficiency annually, especially in patients on long-term therapy, and monitor for signs of lactic acidosis (rare but serious).
